description: Use Leni’s intelligent runtime to answer real-estate, financial, operating, market-research, and organizational questions from your authorized data and durable context. Read portfolio metrics, analyze performance, consult relevant memory, and explicitly save durable preferences while keeping results scoped to your Leni account, organization, and authorized properties. Leni connects to supported property-management and data systems and provides a single runtime for highly accurate, context-aware answers. Learn more or connect your data at https://leni.co/request-demo/.

defaultPrompt: What is my current portfolio occupancy?
